name: Ripples of Potential
oracle_text: Proliferate, then choose any number of permanents you control that had a counter put on them this way. Those permanents phase out. (To proliferate, choose any number of permanents and/or players, then give each another counter of each kind already there. Treat phased-out permanents and anything attached to them as though they don't exist until their controller's next turn.)
blocked_sentences: Proliferate, then choose any number of permanents you control that had a counter put on them this way. Those permanents phase out

needs.what: an `as` option on the `proliferate` op that binds the permanents which actually received a counter from that proliferate (across every repetition under replace_proliferate), so a following `choose_permanents` with objects {binding: <as>, controller: you} can pick any number of them and a `phase_out` can act on the choice
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `proliferate` takes no options at all (op_options is empty) and its implementation picks refs through ask_targets without recording them anywhere; no selector key (has_counters, modified, binding) or value reads 'had a counter put on them this way', and has_counters would wrongly offer every permanent you control carrying a counter, including ones you declined to proliferate
